outcomeNote: A one-clause mishna with no interlocutors; its participial wording is what the following gemara presses on.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַשּׁוֹחֵט בַּלַּיְלָה, וְכֵן הַסּוֹמֵא שֶׁשָּׁחַט – שְׁחִיטָתוֹ כְּשֵׁרָה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «one who slaughters» an animal «at night, and likewise» in the case of «the blind» person «who slaughters» an animal, «his slaughter is valid.»

moves.cueHe: מתני׳ השוחט בלילה, וכן הסומא ששחט
moves.summary: the mishna validates slaughter at night and slaughter by a blind person
